fusions.name: Unshaped Force
fusions.desc: Hurls a shaft of raw force that deals 30 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its resistances.

fusions.name: Overspill Arc
fusions.desc: Spills raw power off the tip through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 arcane damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Exposed] for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Charged Haft
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Discharge
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, a bolt of force leaps from your point at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
